propositions: Standalone file-path execution of reconcile_helpers.py raises ModuleNotFoundError when _commit_binding_store_snapshot() unconditionally imports git_adapter from rebar_reconciler package that does not exist in standalone context.
Commit d9e0f0e733 replaced package-independent subprocess calls with top-level package import, breaking the explicitly documented and tested standalone execution contract.

The helper must resolve git_adapter through the existing sibling loader using canonical key rebar_reconciler.git_adapter and preserve both True/False return semantics and module identity across package-context and standalone paths.
Package-free reconcile.py load should complete without ModuleNotFoundError and reach the documented no-state True, successful-commit True, and failure False branches.
